stories.title: User Registration
stories.description: As a new user, I want to create an account so that I can manage my personal tasks.
acceptance_criteria: User can register using name, email, and password.
Password must contain at least 8 characters.
Successful registration redirects to the login page.

stories.title: User Login
stories.description: As a registered user, I want to log into the application so that I can access my tasks.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in using valid credentials.
Successful login redirects to the dashboard.

stories.title: View Dashboard
stories.description: As a logged-in user, I want to view my dashboard so that I can see all my tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Completed and pending tasks are shown separately.

stories.title: Create Task
stories.description: As a user, I want to create a new task so that I can keep track of my work.
acceptance_criteria: User can select a due date.

stories.title: Edit Task
stories.description: As a user, I want to edit an existing task so that I can update its information.

stories.title: Mark Task Complete
stories.description: As a user, I want to mark a task as completed so that I know it is finished.
acceptance_criteria: Completed tasks display a completed status.
Completed tasks move to the completed section.

stories.title: Delete Task
stories.description: As a user, I want to delete unwanted tasks so that my task list remains clean.

stories.title: Search Tasks
stories.description: As a user, I want to search tasks by title so that I can quickly find them.

stories.title: Filter Tasks
stories.description: As a user, I want to filter tasks by status so that I can easily manage my work.

stories.title: User Logout
stories.description: As a user, I want to securely log out so that no one else can access my account.
acceptance_criteria: Protected pages cannot be accessed after logout.
